topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: I just received another one of those packages, addressed to someone who hasn’t lived here in ages. The nerve! I slam it down on the kitchen table, where it joins the others I’ve been forced to deal with. Every time I open the door to find something new, it’s like the universe is mocking me, insisting I solve someone else's problems. I don’t have time for this. I’ve got my own things to worry about, my own life to live. I glared at the package, as if my frustration could somehow force it to vanish. It’s bad enough the previous tenant left such a mess; now I’m supposed to clean up their mail too?
